# Project: Plinko Trivia

We are building a browser-based trivia game using:
- Next.js
- React
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS

## Game concept
Players answer a predetermined number of trivia questions.
They choose how many balls to drop into a Plinko board and
allocate their questions across those balls.

The landing zone of each ball determines the difficulty
of the questions assigned to it.

The player knows the trivia category before dropping the
balls. Plinko determines difficulty, not category.

## Development guidelines
- Use TypeScript and functional React components.
- Keep components small and reusable.
- Separate game logic from user interface code.
- Explain unfamiliar code and important design decisions.
- Avoid unnecessary libraries and dependencies.
- Prioritise a working MVP before adding advanced features.
- Do not make large changes without explaining the plan.
- Ask before installing new dependencies.
- Make sure the application runs after changes.
